title: Pentagon moves to fire publisher and editor of Stars and Stripes
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. The key update now being reported is: Pentagon moves to fire publisher and editor of Stars and Stripes. In simple words, The Pentagon has given separation notices to both the publisher and the editor-in-chief of Stars and Stripes, according to people familiar with the matter Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. This is a developing story, and verified details may change later.
